decisions.because: Counterexamples (hunt round 3, 2026-10-10): a state file named *.tmp was its own temporary file and rewritten in place (the twin of SUR-C2 missed in round 1); an unreadable state file was not kept aside (ADR-0004) and was lost on the next write.

statement: The state file is replaced atomically through a temporary file named after it (its name plus .tmp), whatever its name; an unreadable or unparseable regular state file is kept aside under the first free .corrupt name before any later write.
